appearances.snippet: Foremost, the 19 special forces group you should know is in the National Guard. ... Plus, they are headquartered in Lehigh, Utah at Camp Williams. ... Camp Williams is 20 minutes down the road from where Charlie (Charlie Kirk) was murdered.

verification.notes: Official Army material identifies the 19th Special Forces Group Airborne as an Army National Guard unit headquartered at Camp Williams, Utah. Camp Williams is near Lehi and the stated roughly 20-minute drive to Utah Valley University is a reasonable approximate travel time, though it varies by route and traffic.
